watch.summary: A streamer claims he is trying to stop trash-talking before immediately contradicting himself and passionately wishing for an opposing team's crowd to be silenced.

beats.what: Streamer starts by saying the team looks good and promises not to hate.
Camera zooms in as he admits he will definitely hate given the chance.
He gets increasingly excited about wanting to quiet the enemy team.
He intensely shouts about wanting the crowd to be quiet while making claw hands in angst.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: I can't wait for the crowd to be quiet!
watch.why: The comedy stems from immediate comedic irony when the streamer vows to stop trash-talking, only to instantly unleash pure, passionate hater energy.
